target_customer: Teams that train and evaluate AI models, especially for biology and science reasoning
problem: Frontier models need hard, verifiable tasks that test how they analyze data, design experiments and use evidence in biology.
business_model: Sale of tasksets for model evaluation and reinforcement learning
product_category: RL environments and evaluation data for biology

founders.name: Marshall Kiely
founders.background_notes: Finance lead at Perplexity, founding AI engineer at Notable Health, ML at Mixpanel; first author papers in Nature and Science on systems biology and metabolomics (per YC page).

competitors.name: Phylo (Biomni Lab)
competitors.what: Applied AI lab with an integrated environment for AI-native biology
competitors.funding_then: $13.5M seed co-led by a16z and Menlo Ventures Anthology Fund

competitors.name: Surge and Mercor
competitors.what: Data labeling firms building RL environments for AI labs

technical_complexity.rationale: Verifiable biology tasks need deep domain expertise to build and validate, which the founder's PhD addresses, but no new research breakthrough is required.

defensibility.rationale: Task quality is the asset but rivals and labs can commission similar tasks; no lock-in is shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to tell; well funded data vendors already target RL environments.

market_need_then: Labs were spending heavily on RL environments in 2025 and 2026 and scientific reasoning was a stated growth area.

branding.domain_note: Uses metalcraft.ai; the plain name is shared by many unrelated metalworking firms.

identity.logo: Symmetric lattice of six interwoven metal bands, described on the site as inspired by the ATP synthase structure
identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific and understated; headline 'Advancing biological models'.

brand_strength.rationale: A coherent logo concept on the company site, but no press or community coverage was found and the name suggests metalworking.

outcome_analysis: Metalcraft is a Fall 2026 YC company building biology tasksets for model evaluation and reinforcement learning. It is days old with a PhD biologist founder, no public funding or customers, and well funded data vendors and biology labs nearby, so no outcome can be assessed yet.
notes: Searches for funding and press found nothing about Metalcraft; results for the similarly named Metal (fundraising software) are a different company. YC lists team size 2 but one named founder. Outcome search is moot for an active company that started in 2026.
